title: Percy Faith “Windmills of Your Mind” (8-Track Tape, Columbia TC8 Orange Shell
descriptionText:
Format: 8-Track Stereo Tape Cartridge
Artist: Percy Faith & His Orchestra
Album / Title: Windmills of Your Mind & Other Great Movie Themes
Label: Columbia / Columbia TC8 (Cat. No. 18-10-0680)
Country: USA
Genre: Orchestral / Easy Listening / Movie Themes
Era: ~1970s
Condition:
Cartridge shell is bright orange, but shows wear (scratches / scuffs).
Label has staining / discoloration; some edge wear.
Tape has not been tested — sold as a collectible / display piece.
Slip case (if included) has damage / worn corners (if applicable).
Notes:
Includes tracks like Windmills of Your Mind (Theme from “The Thomas Crown Affair”) and other film theme songs.
Original Columbia TC8 version — collectors of vintage 8-tracks or Percy Faith material might be especially interested.
